## Purpose

ROSMAP longitudinal cognition model, subject-specific random-slope resilience scores and resilience-by-fraction models for Figure 3F–H.

## Access and execution

This code is for inspection. Restricted participant-level inputs and intermediate objects are not included. Access to the restricted  ROSMAP clinical and neuropathological data is subject to the applicable data-use agreements, and can be requested through https://www.radc.rush.edu/ and https://www.synapse.org/

## Inputs and dependencies

- `dataset_longitudinal.xlsx`: restricted longitudinal cognition (`projid`, `fu_year`, `cogn_global`, `age_at_visit`).
- `dataset_cross_sectional.xlsx`: restricted `projid`, `gpath`, `msex`, `educ`.
- `demogs.xlsx`: restricted `projid`–`Subject` mapping.

```{r display-settings, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE)
```


## Read and join restricted cognition data

```{r read-cognition}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(readr)

#extract longitudinal data for resilience modelling
#read in longitudinal, create baseline measure columns

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# read in longitudinal, create baseline measure columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

longitud <- readxl::read_xlsx("dataset_longitudinal.xlsx") %>% 
  group_by(projid) %>%
  mutate(baseline_cog = cogn_global[fu_year == 0][1], #record baseline cog
         baseline_age = age_at_visit[fu_year == 0][1]) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  #filter(projid %in% long_assays$projid) %>%
 dplyr::select(projid, fu_year, cogn_global, baseline_cog, baseline_age) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cogn_global), !is.na(fu_year)) %>% distinct()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# read in crossec, extract demographic covars for model
# ------------------------------------------------------------

crossec <- readxl::read_xlsx("dataset_cross_sectional.xlsx")

resilience_assay <- longitud %>%
  left_join(crossec, by = "projid") %>%
  filter(!is.na(baseline_cog), !is.na(gpath), !is.na(msex)) #!is.na(Subject)

length(unique(resilience_assay$projid)) # 1972/3984 subjects have cog at baseline, sex, and gpath

# ------------------------------------------------------------
#demogs for projid - subject mapping
# ------------------------------------------------------------
demogs <- read_excel("demogs.xlsx")
```


## Fit the final full-cohort longitudinal model

Inclusion requires at >=3 follow-up (fu) visits and obs for baseline cognition/age, post-mortem pathology score, sex

```{r fit-longitudinal-model}
library(data.table)
library(lme4)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert to data.table
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cog_dt <- as.data.table(resilience_assay)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Keep one row per projid-visit
# long_assays contains repeated protein/fraction rows
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cog_dt <- unique(
  cog_dt[, .(
    projid,
    fu_year,
    cogn_global,
    baseline_cog,
    baseline_age,
    gpath,
    msex)])

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Complete cases
# Do NOT require Subject to be present
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cog_dt <- cog_dt[
  !is.na(projid) &
  !is.na(fu_year) &
  !is.na(cogn_global) &
  !is.na(baseline_cog) &
  !is.na(baseline_age) &
  !is.na(gpath) &
  !is.na(msex)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Check number of observations per projid
# ------------------------------------------------------------
visit_counts <- cog_dt[, .N, by = projid]
visit_counts[order(N)]

# identify subjects with fewer than 3 follow-up observations
visit_counts[N < 3]

valid_projids <- visit_counts[N >= 3, projid]

#filter cog_dt
cog_dt <- cog_dt[projid %in% valid_projids] #1768/1972

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Factor variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cog_dt[, projid := factor(projid)]
cog_dt[, msex := factor(msex)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Scale / centre continuous variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------
cog_dt[, fu_year_c := fu_year]

cog_dt[, baseline_cog_c := as.numeric(scale(baseline_cog))]
cog_dt[, baseline_age_c := as.numeric(scale(baseline_age))]
cog_dt[, gpath_c        := as.numeric(scale(gpath))]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit resilience model
# ------------------------------------------------------------

library(lmerTest)
m_res <- lmer(cogn_global ~ #fixed effects
                fu_year_c + baseline_cog_c + baseline_age_c + msex + gpath_c +
    
    # covariate effects on rate of cognitive change (interaction between effect and longitudinal cognition)
    fu_year_c:baseline_cog_c +
    fu_year_c:baseline_age_c +
    fu_year_c:msex +
    fu_year_c:gpath_c +
    
    # individual deviation from expected intercept and slope
    (1 + fu_year_c | projid),
  
  data = cog_dt,
  REML = TRUE,
  control = lmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))

summary(m_res)
VarCorr(m_res)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract projid-specific residual decline slopes from the resilience model
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ranef_dt <- as.data.table(ranef(m_res)$projid, keep.rownames = "projid")

#random slope = deviation from expected cognitive decline
resilience_scores_all <- ranef_dt[ , .(projid, resilience_slope = fu_year_c)]

#population-average time slope
fixed_time_slope <- fixef(m_res)["fu_year_c"]

# total slope:
# population-average slope + individual deviation
resilience_scores_all[, total_estimated_slope := fixed_time_slope + resilience_slope]

resilience_scores_all[, projid := as.character(projid)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Map the full-cohort resilience scores onto the 75 in the proteomics subjects
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# One row per proteomics Subject/projid
subject_map <- demogs %>% dplyr::select(projid, Subject) %>% unique() %>% as.data.table()

# Extract resilience scores for proteomics subjects only
resilience_scores <- merge(
  subject_map,
  resilience_scores_all,
  by = "projid",
  all.x = TRUE)

# Order by resilience
setorder(resilience_scores, -resilience_slope)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# checks
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Full ROSMAP cohort
hist(
  resilience_scores_all$resilience_slope,
  breaks = 1000,
  main = "All ROSMAP participants",
  xlab = "Resilience slope")
summary(resilience_scores_all$resilience_slope)

# Proteomics cohort only
hist(resilience_scores$resilience_slope,
  breaks = 75,
  main = "Proteomics cohort",
  xlab = "Resilience slope")
summary(resilience_scores$resilience_slope)

# Check all 75 proteomics participants received a score
nrow(resilience_scores)
sum(is.na(resilience_scores$resilience_slope)) #H7 has only 2 visits so is NA
resilience_scores_proteomics <- resilience_scores %>% dplyr::select(-projid)

#write_csv(resilience_scores_proteomics, "resilience_scores.csv")
```


## Figure 3F–G: Cognitive trajectories and resilience


```{r trajectory-plots}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

# ============================================================
# 1) Prepare resilience data
# ============================================================

res_dt_plot <- as.data.table(copy(resilience_scores))
res_dt_plot[, projid := as.character(projid)]
res_dt_plot[, Subject := as.character(Subject)]
res_dt_plot <- res_dt_plot[!is.na(resilience_slope)]  #74 subjects

# ============================================================
# 2) prepare longitudinal trajectory data
# ============================================================

plot_dt <- as.data.table(copy(cog_dt))
plot_dt[, projid := as.character(projid)]
plot_dt <- plot_dt[projid %in% res_dt_plot$projid]

plot_dt[, fitted_subject := predict(m_res, newdata = plot_dt, re.form = NULL)]

plot_dt <- merge(
  plot_dt,
  res_dt_plot[, .(projid, Subject, resilience_slope)],
  by = "projid",
  all.x = TRUE)

setorder(plot_dt, projid, fu_year_c)

# ============================================================
# 3) Add pathology to resilience data
# ============================================================

projid_gpath <- unique(plot_dt[, .(projid, gpath_c)])

res_dt_plot <- merge(
  res_dt_plot,
  projid_gpath,
  by = "projid",
  all.x = TRUE)

# ============================================================
# 4) pathology-predicted decline for visualisation
# ============================================================

beta <- fixef(m_res) #these are the fixed effect predictions

res_dt_plot[, expected_slope := beta["fu_year_c"] + beta["fu_year_c:gpath_c"] * gpath_c]

res_dt_plot[, plotted_slope := expected_slope + resilience_slope]

gpath_grid <- data.table(gpath_c = seq(min(res_dt_plot$gpath_c, na.rm = TRUE),
                                       max(res_dt_plot$gpath_c, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100))

gpath_grid[, expected_slope := beta["fu_year_c"] + beta["fu_year_c:gpath_c"] * gpath_c]

# ============================================================
# 5) Label example subjects
# ============================================================

label_df <- res_dt_plot %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  filter(
    gpath_c > quantile(gpath_c, 0.66, na.rm = TRUE),
    abs(resilience_slope) > quantile(abs(resilience_slope), 0.85, na.rm = TRUE))

# ============================================================
# 6) Cognitive trajectories
# ============================================================

p_traj <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = plot_dt,
    aes(x = fu_year_c, y = cogn_global, group = Subject),
    colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(
    data = plot_dt,
    aes(x = fu_year_c, y = fitted_subject, group = Subject, colour = resilience_slope),
    linewidth = 0.75, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Residual slope\n(resilience)") +
  labs(
    title = "Model-estimated cognitive trajectories",
    subtitle = "Observed (grey) and fitted trajectories",
    x = "Follow-up year",
    y = "Global cognition") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "none")

# ============================================================
# 7) Resilience vs pathology
# ============================================================

p_gpath_resilience <- ggplot(res_dt_plot, aes(x = gpath_c, y = plotted_slope)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(xend = gpath_c, y = expected_slope, yend = plotted_slope),
    colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.35, alpha = 0.65) +
  geom_line(
    data = gpath_grid,
    aes(x = gpath_c, y = expected_slope),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey65") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = resilience_slope), size = 2.8, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = Subject),
    size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.25, point.padding = 0.25, segment.size = 0.2) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Residual slope\n(resilience)") +
  labs(
    title = "Resilience as deviation from expected decline",
    subtitle = "Lines show subject-specific deviation from pathology-predicted decline",
    x = "Global pathology burden (scaled)",
    y = "Cognitive decline rate\n(more negative = faster decline)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10))
```

## Figure 3H: Resilience-by-fraction models


```{r fit-resilience-interactions}
library(lme4)
library(dplyr)
library(performance)
library(tibble)
library(readr)

fit_fraction_resilience_models <- function(
    gene_list,
    dataframe,
    assay_to_use = c("imputed", "unimputed"),
    dataset_label = NULL,
    feature_var = "Genes",
    response_var = "log2_value",
    resilience_var = "resilience_slope",
    fraction_var = "Fraction",
    subject_var = "Subject",
    pmi_var = "pmi",
    age_var = "age_death", #added age at death as a new variable (suggested by David Bennett)
    fraction_levels = as.character(1:7),
    scale_continuous = TRUE,
    min_rows = 10,
    fdr_method = "BH") {
  
  assay_to_use <- match.arg(assay_to_use)
  if (is.null(dataset_label)) dataset_label <- assay_to_use
  
  df0 <- dataframe %>%
    filter(assay_type == assay_to_use) %>%
    mutate(
      !!fraction_var := factor(.data[[fraction_var]], levels = fraction_levels),
      !!subject_var := factor(.data[[subject_var]]))
  
  if (scale_continuous) {
    
    df0[[paste0(resilience_var, "_z")]] <- as.numeric(scale(df0[[resilience_var]]))
    df0[[paste0(pmi_var, "_z")]] <- as.numeric(scale(df0[[pmi_var]]))
    df0[[paste0(age_var, "_z")]] <- as.numeric(scale(df0[[age_var]]))
    
    resilience_term <- paste0(resilience_var, "_z")
    pmi_term <- paste0(pmi_var, "_z")
    age_term <- paste0(age_var, "_z") } 
  
  else {
    resilience_term <- resilience_var
    pmi_term <- pmi_var
    age_term <- age_var }
  
  reduced_formula <- as.formula(
    paste(response_var, "~", paste(
        c(fraction_var, resilience_term, pmi_term, age_term,
          paste0(pmi_term, ":", fraction_var),
          paste0(age_term, ":", fraction_var)),
        collapse = " + " ),
      "+ (1 |", subject_var, ")"))
  
  full_formula <- as.formula(
    paste(response_var, "~",
      paste(
        c(fraction_var, resilience_term, pmi_term, age_term,
          paste0(pmi_term, ":", fraction_var),
          paste0(age_term, ":", fraction_var),
          paste0(resilience_term, ":", fraction_var)),
        collapse = " + " ),
      "+ (1 |", subject_var, ")"))
  
  results <- vector("list", length(gene_list))
  names(results) <- gene_list
  
  for (gene in gene_list) {
    
    dat_g <- df0 %>%
      filter(.data[[feature_var]] == gene) %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(.data[[response_var]]),
        !is.na(.data[[fraction_var]]),
        !is.na(.data[[subject_var]]),
        !is.na(.data[[resilience_term]]),
        !is.na(.data[[pmi_term]]))
    
    if (nrow(dat_g) < min_rows || nlevels(dat_g[[fraction_var]]) < 2) next
    
    model_noint <- try(
      lmer(
        reduced_formula,
        data = dat_g,
        REML = FALSE,
        control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))),
      silent = TRUE)
    
    model_full <- try(
      lmer(full_formula, data = dat_g, REML = FALSE,
        control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5))),
      silent = TRUE)
    
    if (inherits(model_noint, "try-error") || inherits(model_full, "try-error")) next
    if (any(is.na(fixef(model_full)))) next
    
    an <- try(anova(model_noint, model_full), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(an, "try-error")) next
    
    pval <- an$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
    chisq <- an$Chisq[2]
    if (is.na(pval)) next
    
    r2_noint <- suppressWarnings(r2_nakagawa(model_noint)$R2_marginal)
    r2_full  <- suppressWarnings(r2_nakagawa(model_full)$R2_marginal)
    
    results[[gene]] <- tibble(
      Genes = gene,
      dataset = dataset_label,
      predictor = resilience_var,
      n_obs = nrow(dat_g),
      n_subjects = n_distinct(dat_g[[subject_var]]),
      chi_sq = chisq,
      p_value = pval,
      delta_margin_r2 = r2_full - r2_noint,
      singular_reduced = isSingular(model_noint, tol = 1e-4),
      singular_full = isSingular(model_full, tol = 1e-4) )
  }
  
  out <- bind_rows(results) %>%
    mutate(padj = p.adjust(p_value, method = fdr_method)) %>%
    arrange(padj, p_value)
  
  list(
    full_list_mixmod = out,
    significant_mixmod = out %>% filter(padj < 0.05))
}

res_resilience <- fit_fraction_resilience_models(
  gene_list = model_gene_list,
  dataframe = prop_long,
  assay_to_use = "unimputed",
  dataset_label = "unimputed",
  resilience_var = "resilience_slope",
  pmi_var = "pmi",
  age_var = "age_death",
  scale_continuous = TRUE)

res_resilience_imp <- fit_fraction_resilience_models(
  gene_list = model_gene_list,
  dataframe = prop_long,
  assay_to_use = "imputed",
  dataset_label = "imputed",
  resilience_var = "resilience_slope",
  pmi_var = "pmi",
  age_var = "age_death",
  scale_continuous = TRUE)


res_resilience$significant_mixmod %>% arrange(desc(delta_margin_r2)) #54 from unimputed analysis
res_resilience_imp$significant_mixmod %>% arrange(desc(delta_margin_r2)) #29 from imputed

all_genes <- union(res_resilience$significant_mixmod$Genes, res_resilience_imp$significant_mixmod$Genes) #59 across both models

intersection <- res_resilience$significant_mixmod %>% filter(Genes %in% res_resilience_imp$significant_mixmod$Genes) #24/59 total (24 robust to imputation strategy)
range(intersection$delta_margin_r2) #effect size (marginal R2) range: 0.003-0.084

#14 of the intersection are present in the 217 robust AD/CON/RES categorical model results

#write_csv(res_resilience$full_list_mixmod, "resilience_slope_final.csv")
#write_csv(res_resilience_imp$full_list_mixmod, "imp_resilience_slope_final.csv")
```


## Figure 3H: Plot stable resilience results

```{r resilience-volcano}
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

res_resil <- res_resilience$full_list_mixmod #all modelled (for full volcano) = 4794
res_resil_signif <- res_resil %>% filter(padj <= 0.05) #all significant from the unimputed analysis (for labelling) = 54

# results table
df <- as_tibble(res_resil) %>% mutate(log10pval = -log10(p_value))

# genes significant in both the imputed and unimputed analyses
stable_genes <- intersection %>% pull(Genes) %>% unique() # 24/54 are robust to imputation strategy

# add a logical 'robust' indicator to df
df <- df %>% mutate(is_stable = Genes %in% stable_genes)

# all significant results to label
top_labels <- df %>% filter(padj < 0.05)

## optimising to prevent label overlap...
#OR just Label only the 24 stable significant genes
top_labels <- df %>% filter(padj < 0.05, is_stable)
#OR the 24 stable and non-stable when R2 > 2% 
top_labels <- df %>% filter(padj < 0.05, is_stable | (!is_stable & delta_margin_r2 > 0.02)) #

plot_resilience <- ggplot(
  df, aes(
    x = delta_margin_r2,
    y = log10pval)) +

  #non-significant background
  geom_point(
    data = filter(df, padj >= 0.05),
    colour = "grey85",
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.5) +

  #significant, non-robust results: open circles
  geom_point(
  data = filter(df, padj < 0.05, !is_stable),
  aes(colour = padj),
  shape = 1,
  stroke = 0.9,
  size = 2) +

#significant AND robust results: filled circles
  geom_point(
  data = filter(df, padj < 0.05, is_stable),
  aes(colour = padj),
  shape = 16,
  size = 2.25,
  alpha = 0.9) +

  # gene labels
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_labels,
    aes(
      label = Genes,
      colour = padj),
    size = 2.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    max.overlaps = 30,
    max.iter = 20000,
    force = 2,
    force_pull = 0.8,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.15,
    min.segment.length = 0) +

  scale_colour_gradient(
    low = "#006D77",
    high = "#A7C957",
    trans = "reverse",
    name = "FDR (padj)" ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 10,
    base_family = "Helvetica") +

  labs(
    title = "Resilience × Fraction interaction",
    subtitle = "Top significant proteins labelled",
    x = expression(Delta * " marginal R"^2),
    y = expression(-log[10](p-value))) +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 10),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10))

plot_resilience
```
